basis: Excessive erythrocytosis and sustained hypoxemia define the syndrome; pulmonary hypertension is variable and thrombotic risk alone adds no cardiovascular axis.
Severe developmental delay and cerebral abnormalities; optic atrophy in 1/2 patients (~50%) supports ocular involvement; increased skull ossification alone does not establish damage.
Nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss, documented in 4/4 patients.
Congenital cleft affects the upper lip and alveolar bone, with impaired mastication; nasal shape changes alone do not establish airway damage.
Astrocytic tumor arising in the diencephalon; endocrine or visual damage is not established across this tumor group.
Congenital pulmonary valve and arterial malformation; persistent bronchial compression and airway malacia affect roughly half, particularly in infantile presentations.
Spondyloepiphyseal skeletal dysplasia affects vertebrae, epiphyses and joints; documented in 20/20 patients.
Central auditory recognition deficit classified as agnosia; no peripheral hearing-organ damage is inherent.
Meniere disease affects cochlear hearing and the inner-ear vestibular apparatus.
Acne is a disorder of cutaneous pilosebaceous units; adult onset does not establish an endocrine or infectious disease.
Benign lymphatic malformation/neoplasm arising in skin; no blood-vessel or immune disorder is established.
Congenital urethral malformation with urinary dysfunction; pelvic girdle bony abnormalities occur in 30-79%.
Malignant mesenchymal soft-tissue tumor in the solitary fibrous tumor spectrum; no specific visceral or CNS origin is supplied.
Hydrocephalus and scapular/costovertebral defects define disease; dental enamel defects occur in 30-79%; pigmentation/photosensitivity alone do not establish skin injury.
Telomere disorder characterized by marrow failure, nail/skin abnormalities and oral leukoplakia; pulmonary fibrosis is not established in >=30% of this subtype.
Inherited susceptibility specifically targets noise-induced hearing loss; the concept does not establish existing hearing impairment.
MYH2 congenital skeletal myopathy with defining ophthalmoplegia and ptosis; dysphagia alone does not establish separate gastrointestinal damage.
Ichthyosis/alopecia and corneal disease define IFAP; developmental impairment/seizures occur in 80-99%, immunodeficiency in 30-79%; infections alone add no pulmonary axis.
Autonomic baroreflex dysfunction is defined by severe blood-pressure instability, including hypertension and abnormal heart-rate regulation.
Microcephaly and ocular malformations define disease; thyroid hypoplasia/hypothyroidism and sensorineural hearing loss occur in 30-79%; renal/vascular/skeletal findings omitted by cap.
Heart defects, splenic abnormalities and intestinal malrotation characterize heterotaxy; developmental delay reported in 1/1 evaluated; bronchial isomerism alone adds no lung damage.
Disorder of ocular motility; an underlying neurologic or vestibular disease is not inherent to every case.
Primary breast carcinoma; breast lies outside the 13 axes, and no qualifying extra-breast involvement is established.
Localized dermal atrophy produces depressed hyperpigmented plaques; proposed morphea and Borrelia associations do not establish an autoimmune or infectious mechanism.
Complex I metabolic defect; developmental delay 3/3, skeletal muscle atrophy 2/3 and sensorineural hearing loss 1/3 (~33%); respiratory infections alone add no lung damage.
